note: UNGRD's Sept 3, 06:30 balance updated the count to 4,519 injured and 122 missing (down from the presidency/Medicina Legal's Aug 29–30 figure of 152), across 466,606 people affected in 293,743 families, 498 municipios, 16 departments. Death toll held flat at 331.

Missing count peaked near 420 in early estimates before narrowing to 290+ (Aug 19), 260+ (Aug 20), 234 (Aug 23), back up to 240 (Aug 25), then 219 in UNGRD's Aug 27 balance. Medicina Legal's forensic reconciliation put active cases at 152 on Aug 29, adopted by the presidency Aug 30. UNGRD's own Sept 3, 06:30 balance now narrows the figure further to 122, its lowest reported total to date.

Families affected across 498 municipios in the 16 departments referenced by UNGRD's Sept 3-cutoff balance — a sharp jump in family count from 193,011 families (406,113 individuals) on Aug 27, even though the individuals-affected total is roughly flat, suggesting a methodology or registration-driven revision rather than new displacement.
